A.notes: Strongest a11y work: field errors wired via aria-describedby with actionable examples, many live regions, zero long animations under reduced motion, solid 2px focus outline. Ledger surfaces credits/negatives clearly and the empty state tells you how to recover.
A.best: Actionable error and empty-state copy plus reduced-motion compliance
issues: Em-dash placeholders for missing values measure ~2.97:1 in light theme

J.notes: Only variant with zero sampled text-contrast failures in both themes, and zero long animations under reduced motion. Ledger summary ('14 entries · 3 overdue') and header copy communicate the messy data well.
J.best: Clean contrast in both themes plus informative ledger summary
issues: Retry in failed-save state reads as plain text, weak affordance
No-results empty state collapsed into a single table row, less prominent

C.notes: Best UX writing: missing values become 'Not tied to a project', 'No due date', 'Set when sent'; totals note 'net of 1 credit'; long client names wrap instead of truncating. Errors are described to fields.
C.best: Plain-language handling of missing ledger values
issues: Motion not reduced under prefers-reduced-motion (12 long animations)
Small muted counts ~4.35:1 in light theme

M.notes: Looks like baseline but semantics improved: role=alert field errors, aria-describedby, alertdialog for discard, heading structure, guidance 'To continue, enter a valid billing email'. Reduced motion largely honored.
M.best: Error semantics and the explanatory disabled-Next hint

D.notes: Wraps long names, clear error copy ('Enter the full email address, like billing@client.com'), helpful search placeholder, no dark-theme contrast failures. Good live regions.
D.best: Dark theme passes contrast; wrapped long names
issues: Next stays visually enabled while form is invalid

K.notes: Near-baseline; adds a step progress bar and 'Step 1 of 3'. Errors partly described (2 of 3 fields).

G.notes: Essentially baseline with errors linked via aria-describedby on 2 fields. No visible regressions.

F.notes: Visually identical to baseline; adds aria-describedby on two fields. Neutral.

H.notes: Visually identical to baseline with minor error association; more animations under reduced motion (19 vs 13).

B.notes: Indistinguishable from baseline; field errors still not programmatically associated.
issues: Errors not linked to inputs (0 aria-describedby)

E.notes: Good error copy and live regions, but form inputs lose visible boundaries (invisible in dark), phone layout crushes project cards into three unreadable columns, and grey text is faint throughout.
E.best: Restructured failed-save message with clear title and Retry
issues: Text inputs have no visible boundary (WCAG 1.4.11)
Phone layout broken: 3-column cards with wrapped words
Several focus stops with no visible ring
